15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3011|463ccfcd.name: Teg Dawnstrider
3011|463ccfcd.text: Enchanting has run in our family for generations. I learned at an early age, just as my son is doing now.

3028|c2467ddc.name: Kah Mistrunner
3028|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3064|8223e188.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|8223e188.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3084|13ee0873.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|13ee0873.text: Metal, as with all things, should be used in balance with nature.  Karn Stonehoof has a smithy setup near the pond on the lower rise.  Seek out his wisdom.

3084|b2444ac7.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|b2444ac7.text:
Don't blame you for taking up fishing.  Mulgore has some the best fishing spots in Southern Kalimdor and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle on the high rise has all of the gear you'll need to take advantage of it.

Tell Kah Mistrunner that I sent ya!

744-complete.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-complete.text:
Thank you for your help, $N.

My part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.
744-complete.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-progress.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-progress.text: This headdress will certainly be a wonderful gift for my brother.
744-progress.title: Preparation for Ceremony

746-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  This will calm the beasts of Mulgore.  And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
746-complete.title: Dwarven Digging

746-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have the Broken Tools?  The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore.  This defilement must be stopped!
746-progress.title: Dwarven Digging

758-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-complete.text:
Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
758-complete.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

759-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-accept.text:
There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.

Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
759-accept.title: Wildmane Totem

8368-accept.name: Horde Warbringer
8368-accept.text:
The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance.  Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.

Do not let this happen, $N!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
8368-accept.title: Battle of Warsong Gulch

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-complete.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-complete.text:
You have done well, friend.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $N. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.
97485-complete.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-progress.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-progress.text:
There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.

Or it could be something else entirely.

Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
97485-progress.title: Traditions of the Bluff
